title: Information from the "details" tab for a network is cut off with long text in certain languages
line: Long labels in a network's Details tab, like Spanish "Servidor de nombres principal para IPv4", now show in full instead of being cut in the middle.
explanation: Each row of the Details tab was a single item spanning both grid columns, with the label anchored to the left half and the value to the right half. Long labels, common in translations, could never use more than half the width, so they were elided in the middle with no way to read them. The change makes labels and values separate cells of the same GridLayout: the split stays in the middle while everything fits, and the label column grows to the longest label's width otherwise, with values eliding as before (right-click Copy still copies them in full).

commits.message:
applet: Let the connection details label column fit its labels

Long labels in a connection's Details tab, common in translations, were
cut in the middle because each row split its width in half. Make labels
and values cells of one grid, so the label column grows to fit them.

BUG: 453035

patches.diff:
From ef8e47c71c9488f7567af91178e6d5a371cbc73b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:18:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: Let the connection details label column fit its
 labels

Long labels in a connection's Details tab, common in translations, were
cut in the middle because each row split its width in half. Make labels
and values cells of one grid, so the label column grows to fit them.

BUG: 453035
---
 applet/DetailsText.qml | 141 ++++++++++++++++++++++-------------------
 1 file changed, 75 insertions(+), 66 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applet/DetailsText.qml b/applet/DetailsText.qml
index 8c880d347..e4b73454f 100644
--- a/applet/DetailsText.qml
+++ b/applet/DetailsText.qml
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
 
 pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
 
+import QtQml.Models
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 
@@ -50,84 +51,92 @@ MouseArea {
         columns: 2
         rowSpacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 4
 
+        // Labels and values are separate cells, so that the label column can
+        // grow to fit the longest label; values elide if there is no room left.
         Repeater {
-            id: repeater
+            model: root.detailsModel
+
+            delegate: DelegateChooser {
+                role: "isSection"
+
+                // Basically ListSectionHeader but centered and without the line.
+                DelegateChoice {
+                    roleValue: true
+
+                    Kirigami.Heading {
+                        required property int index
+                        required property string sectionTitle
+
+                        Layout.row: index
+                        Layout.columnSpan: 2
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        Layout.preferredHeight: Math.round(implicitHeight * 1.2) // Add some padding for sections
+
+                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignBottom
+                        elide: Text.ElideRight
+                        opacity: 0.75
+                        level: 5
+                        type: Kirigami.Heading.Primary
+                        text: sectionTitle
+                        font.weight: Font.Bold
+                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                    }
+                }
+
+                DelegateChoice {
+                    roleValue: false
+
+                    PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                        required property int index
+                        required property string detailLabel
+                        required property string detailValue
+
+                        Layout.row: index
+                        Layout.column: 0
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        Layout.preferredWidth: (detailsGrid.width - detailsGrid.columnSpacing) / 2
+                        Layout.minimumWidth: implicitWidth
+
+                        visible: detailLabel || detailValue
+                        font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
+                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
+                        text: `${detailLabel}:`
+                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                        opacity: 0.6
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
 
+        Repeater {
             model: root.detailsModel
 
-            delegate: Item {
-                id: delegateItem
+            delegate: PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                id: detailValueItem
 
-                // Required properties from ConnectionDetailsModel
+                required property int index
                 required property bool isSection
-                required property string sectionTitle
                 required property string detailLabel
                 required property string detailValue
 
+                Layout.row: index
+                Layout.column: 1
                 Layout.fillWidth: true
-                Layout.columnSpan: 2
-                Layout.preferredHeight: {
-                    if (delegateItem.isSection) {
-                        return Math.round(sectionTitleLabel.implicitHeight * 1.2); // Add some padding for sections
-                    } else if (delegateItem.detailLabel || delegateItem.detailValue) {
-                        return detailLabelItem.implicitHeight;
-                    }
-                    return 0; // Hide empty items
-                }
-
-                // Basically ListSectionHeader but centered and without the line.
-                Kirigami.Heading {
-                    id: sectionTitleLabel
-                    anchors.fill: parent
-                    visible: delegateItem.isSection
-                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
-                    verticalAlignment: Text.AlignBottom
-                    elide: Text.ElideRight
-                    opacity: 0.75
-                    level: 5
-                    type: Kirigami.Heading.Primary
-                    text: delegateItem.sectionTitle
-                    font.weight: Font.Bold
-                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
-                }
+                Layout.preferredWidth: (detailsGrid.width - detailsGrid.columnSpacing) / 2
 
-                // Detail Label
-                PlasmaComponents3.Label {
-                    id: detailLabelItem // Renamed from labelItem
-                    anchors.left: parent.left
-                    anchors.right: parent.horizontalCenter
-                    anchors.rightMargin: detailsGrid.columnSpacing / 2
-
-                    visible: !delegateItem.isSection && (delegateItem.detailLabel || delegateItem.detailValue)
-                    elide: Text.ElideMiddle
-                    font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
-                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
-                    text: `${delegateItem.detailLabel}:`
-                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
-                    opacity: 0.6
-                }
+                visible: !isSection && (detailLabel || detailValue)
+                elide: Text.ElideRight
+                font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
+                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignLeft
+                text: detailValue
+                textFormat: Text.PlainText
 
-                // Detail Value
-                PlasmaComponents3.Label {
-                    id: detailValueItem
-                    anchors.left: parent.horizontalCenter
-                    anchors.leftMargin: detailsGrid.columnSpacing / 2
-                    anchors.right: parent.right
-
-                    visible: !delegateItem.isSection && (delegateItem.detailLabel || delegateItem.detailValue)
-                    elide: Text.ElideRight
-                    font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
-                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignLeft
-                    text: delegateItem.detailValue
-                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
-                    opacity: 1
-
-                    MouseArea {
-                        anchors.fill: parent
-                        acceptedButtons: Qt.RightButton
-                        onPressed: mouse => {
-                            contextMenu.show(this, detailValueItem.text, mouse.x, mouse.y);
-                        }
+                MouseArea {
+                    anchors.fill: parent
+                    acceptedButtons: Qt.RightButton
+                    onPressed: mouse => {
+                        contextMenu.show(this, detailValueItem.text, mouse.x, mouse.y);
                     }
                 }
             }
--
